meta.title: Turn costs
meta.description: Show estimated model cost, request counts and token pricing below each completed turn.

inherited: Inherited history; excluded from new spending in this branch
scope: Model requests in this session only. Subagents, title generation and tool charges are excluded. Estimates use API usage and configured prices; the provider invoice is authoritative.
timeRule: Estimates use the actual provider and configured rates. Unknown rates are not zero. Peak rates use request start time.
history: Historical replay uses saved price snapshots. New routes are priced only from their coverage start.
session: New session model cost through this turn: {amount}
sessionPartial: Some calls are missing from this subtotal.
unpriced: {count} plan or usage-only calls are excluded from monetary totals.
subscription: Plan/quota route: usage is shown without treating public API prices as account charges.
usage-only: Usage-only route; no monetary cost is calculated.
price-incomplete: Some rates are unknown. Only the known subtotal is shown.
dockRunning: Current turn is running and not included; amounts cover completed turns only.
dockSettled: Updated after each turn ends, including failed and interrupted turns.
dockScope: New model calls in this session only. Inherited fork history, independent child sessions and tool fees are excluded. Amounts are estimates; provider billing takes precedence.
